server responds with compatible version and declared tools/resources
tools/list and tools/call; resources/list and resources/read only if implemented

wire: One JSON-RPC message per line; stdout contains only protocol messages; diagnostics use stderr.

tool_mapping.purpose: Business statement to explicit alternative causal questions and missing information
tool_mapping.limits: No automatic truth or unique target

tool_mapping.purpose: Validate graph syntax, timing and evidence for proposed edges
tool_mapping.limits: Syntactic checks do not establish causal graph correctness

tool_mapping.purpose: Run a selected declared discovery method and preserve equivalence class
tool_mapping.limits: No arbitrary latent temporal inference; candidate engine qualification required

tool_mapping.purpose: Identify under a supplied graph or return a bounded nonidentification/unsupported disposition
tool_mapping.limits: causal_workflow.adjustment_expression handles a supplied DAG/back-door case; unsupported adjustment is not general nonidentification
No automatic bank experimentation or assignment truth

tool_mapping.purpose: Run a declared estimator in a declared sampling/model regime
tool_mapping.limits: R01/R03 are qualified only in their registered synthetic scopes; R02/R04/R05 remain negative
Sensitivity sets, sampling confidence and posterior credibility remain distinct

tool_mapping.purpose: Check source ownership, inclusion, measurement and information-clock declarations
tool_mapping.limits: Checks cannot manufacture gold truth or validate declarations scientifically

tool_mapping.purpose: Render an evidence-grounded report with conditional/negative conclusions
tool_mapping.limits: A report does not promote capability or claim independent acceptance
Availability is exact runtime-specific, not inferred from package names

tool_mapping.purpose: Inspect authorized durable job state and result handles
tool_mapping.limits: No scientific conclusion follows from completed job status

tool_mapping.purpose: Request cooperative cancellation of an authorized job
tool_mapping.limits: May race with completion; published complete result remains immutable

tool_result: Canonical response in structuredContent, plus the same JSON serialized as a text content block for compatibility. outputSchema is the actual response schema.

error_mapping.protocol: Unknown tool/malformed CallToolRequest follows JSON-RPC error behavior.
error_mapping.tool_error: Input validation/API/system failure is isError=true with actionable structured error.
error_mapping.scientific_disposition: An honestly computed unsupported/not_identified/refused result is isError=false with its disposition; it cannot carry invented numerical output.

resources: Opaque artifact resources under causal-artifact scheme; metadata and controlled bounded reads only. No implicit access to all local file paths.
long_jobs: Application job handles and explicit job.status/job.cancel tools preserve parity with the library/CLI. Do not advertise optional protocol task support unless implemented and separately tested.
progress: Use request-supplied progressToken only while that request is active; monotone progress; no notifications after completion. Poll application job.status for durable work beyond a completed tools/call.
cancellation: notifications/cancelled applies to an in-flight RPC, not an already returned durable job handle. Do not cancel initialize. Durable job cancellation uses explicit application tool and reports race-safe terminal state.
model_boundary: No model call or sampling capability enabled implicitly. LLM-generated text cannot change authorized roots or invoke arbitrary code.

current_standard_comparison.observed_change: Per-request metadata and mandatory server/discover replace the legacy initialization handshake; stdio has modern/legacy discovery rules.
current_standard_comparison.decision: Defer modern protocol claims until a compatible SDK and real dual-era conformance tests are selected. Keep this legacy compatibility choice explicit in the chapter.

required_execution_evidence: IN04 must actually call the server from a client at the pinned revision and preserve captured request/result/error/fault evidence. IN05 qualifies whole workflows; IN02 designs the contract only.
